changelog.title: OASIS Ring Competition System
changelog.description: Ready Player One-inspired competitive artifact system. 8 legendary Rings (one per house), each held by the highest scorer on that ring's 60-second rapid-fire challenge. 320 questions across 8 domains, streak multipliers, speed bonuses, Firestore-backed ownership tracking, Ring Gallery / Hall of Bearers page with animated SVG ring icons. 9 new OASIS achievements including Lord of the Rings (hold all 8).

changelog.title: Backup or Bust Survival Mode
changelog.description: Upgraded from static quiz to survival game: 3 lives, 30-second timer (decreases with waves), disaster events between waves, combo multipliers up to 3x, high score tracking. 30 questions covering backup types, RAID levels, RPO/RTO, DR planning, and business continuity.

changelog.title: Dark Gates 8-13 — Advanced CTF Expansion
changelog.description: 6 new Dark Arts gate challenges forming Tier 5 (Master): Network Forensics (PCAP analysis), Binary Analysis (hex dump decode), Threat Hunting (SIEM attack chains), Crypto Challenge (multi-layer decode), Social Engineering (phishing OPSEC), and The Synthesis (5-stage boss combining all skills).

changelog.title: Secret Features & Easter Eggs
changelog.description: Hidden discovery mechanics: Nocturnal Mode (automatic dark theme 10pm-6am), Konami code trigger (Matrix digital rain animation), typed secret commands, triple-click and multi-click discoveries, session milestones. 3 new secret achievements.

changelog.title: Factionless Skill Tree
changelog.description: Breadth-based progression system for Divergent users. 5 branches (Recon, Engineering, Network, Crypto, Operations) mapping pairs of houses. 3 tiers per branch (Bronze/Silver/Gold). Titles progress from Factionless through Wanderer, Pathfinder, Polymath, Prime, to The Divergent.

changelog.title: Personality-Based Sorting Quiz v2
changelog.description: Complete rewrite of house sorting from skill-based to personality-based algorithm. 15 scenario questions with themed choices that map to house archetypes. Supports all 11 houses plus Factionless detection.

changelog.title: GOT-Style Title Progression
changelog.description: Multi-layered title system: house identity, 5-tier skill levels, and a cumulative GOT-style title that grows with mastery. Titles displayed in dashboard header and profile.

changelog.title: Dark Arts Guided Walkthroughs
changelog.description: 5-step progressive SVG walkthroughs added to Dynamic Analysis (sandbox log → behavior diagram) and Static Analysis (PE file anatomy). Click-to-answer with wrong-answer feedback scaffolds the mental model before freeform builders.

changelog.title: CyberOps Completion Stamps
changelog.description: Visual completion tracking for CyberOps course. Stamps persist in localStorage, display on course index and dashboard. ModuleProgress bridges to CompletionStamp on module/quiz completion.

changelog.title: Core 2 404 Fix & Monitoring
changelog.description: Fixed broken cross-links in A+ Core 2 chapters 15-17. EduScan PATH-004 promoted to CI profile to catch anchor path issues going forward.

changelog.title: Guided CFG Walkthrough
changelog.description: Reverse Engineering module now includes a 5-step guided walkthrough before the CFG Builder. Students decompose a simple assembly snippet into a progressively-revealed SVG control flow graph with click-to-answer interaction, building the mental model before tackling the freeform builder.

changelog.title: Reverse Engineering Lab Conversion
changelog.description: RE module converted from auto-complete to proper lab format with Tier 2 gate enforcement. Section completion now requires passing interactive challenges.

changelog.title: Anonymous Classroom Enrollment
changelog.description: Students can now join classroom sessions without accounts. Progress tracked anonymously via session tokens for live instructor dashboards.

changelog.title: Host Error Detector (HED)
changelog.description: Runtime error monitoring system for live sessions. Captures and reports JavaScript errors across all pages for proactive debugging.
